summary: Evogene Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching an investor presentation discussing its AI-driven small-molecule discovery platform and forward-looking statements. The filing is a routine periodic report furnishing a corporate presentation, not a special-situation event. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, or other corporate action is announced. The registrant is the filer; the filing contains no binding offer, board recommendation, or deal terms. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K is the equivalent of a routine current report on Form 8-K for US companies and does not trigger a special-situation classification.
